attempts.summary: Built a redundant dual-transit-path topology between node1 (VyOS) and node2 (OPNsense), each fronting a private LAN (node3 behind node1, node4 behind node2), using OSPF (FRR on both routers) for automatic, stateless failover between the two independent transit networks. Verified private-to-private reachability in both directions, demonstrated a live failover (disabling one transit link) with zero packet loss on a continuous ping, verified recovery when the link was restored, then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart of all four nodes with boot-identity and service/connectivity proof for each.
